def choose_move(observation):
    # Get environment type with default fallback
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "resource_collection")
    # Self and opponent positions
    sx, sy = observation.get("self_position", (0, 0))
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", (0, 0))
    
    # Defensive access for environment-specific behaviors
    
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        role = observation.get("self_role", "pursuer")
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
            dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
            return [dx, dy]
        # Strategic move toward a corner to cut off evader
        corners = [
            [0, 0],
            [0, observation.get("grid_height", 1) - 1),
            [observation.get("grid_width", 1) - 1), 0],
            [observation.get("grid_width", 1) - 1), observation.get("grid_height", 1) - 1),
        ]
        target = max(corners, key=lambda item: abs(item[0] - ox) + abs(item[1] - oy))
        dx = 0 if target[0] == sx else (1 if target[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if target[1] == sy else (1 if target[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    
    if env == "territory_control":
        targets = (
            observation.get("unclaimed_cells") or
            observation.get("opponent_territory") or
            []
        )
        if not targets:
            return [0, 0]
        # Move toward nearest unclaimed or opponent territory
        best = min(targets, key=lambda item: abs(item[0] - sx) + abs(item[1] - sy))
        dx = 0 if best[0] == sx else (1 if best[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if best[1] == sy else (1 if best[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    
    # For resource collection or default
    resources = observation.get("resources") or []
    if resources:
        best = min(resources, key=lambda item: abs(item[0] - sx) + abs(item[1] - sy))
        dx = 0 if best[0] == sx else (1 if best[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if best[1] == sy else (1 if best[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    
    # Fallback to moving towards opponent if no resources
    dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
    dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
    return [dx, dy]

    wx, wy = observation['grid_width'], observation['grid_height']
    sx, sy = observation['self_position']
    ox, oy = observation['opponent_position']
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    obstacles = set(observation.get('obstacles', []))

    target = None
    if resources:
        target = min(resources, key=lambda r: dist((sx, sy), r))
    elif observation.get('remaining_resource_count', 0) > 0:
        target = (sx, sy)
    else:
        target = None
    moves = {
        (sx, sy-1): [0, -1],
        (sx, sy+1): [0, 1],
        (sx-1, sy): [-1, 0],
        (sx+1, sy): [1, 0]
    }
    candidates = []

            else:
                candidates.append((0, move))
    if candidates:
        _, best_move = min(candidates, key=lambda c: c[0])
        return best_move

    return [0, 0]
